subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Srinagar (Summer), Jammu (Winter). Jammu and Kashmir covers a geographic area of 42,241 sq km across 20 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Jhelum (Vyath), Chenab, Tawi, Indus, Kishanganga.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Reorganized as a Union Territory with a Legislative Assembly on 31 October 2019. Celebrated worldwide as the 'Paradise on Earth'. Renowned for Dal Lake, saffron (Kashmiri Mongra), Pashmina wool, and Vaishno Devi shrine.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Jammu and Kashmir was formally instituted on 31 October 2019. Official language(s): Kashmiri, Dogri, Urdu, Hindi, English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Rouf, Dumhal, Kud dance, Bhand Pather.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Tulip Festival (Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden), Shikara Festival, Navreh, Baisakhi.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is Manoj Sinha.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir is Omar Abdullah.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh (Srinagar/Jammu).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Kashmir stag (Hangul) | State Bird: Kalij pheasant | State Flower: Lotus | State Tree: Chinar (Platanus orientalis).

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Lithium (Reasi discovery, 5.9 million tonnes), Limestone, Gypsum, Bauxite, Marble.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Jammu and Kashmir plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine, Amarnath Cave, Shankaracharya Temple, Shalimar & Nishat Mughal Gardens, Chenab Rail Bridge (world's highest rail bridge, 359m).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Dachigam National Park (last home of Hangul), Kishtwar National Park, Kazinag National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT, Mission Youth, Mumkin Scheme.
